import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SerreTwistSections
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.ModuleGlobalGeneration

/-!
# Global generation of the carried projective twist

The coordinate section of `O(1)` is a generator on its own standard chart.
This uses the coordinate sections of the actual glued Serre twist.
-/

open CategoryTheory Limits MvPolynomial HomogeneousLocalization

noncomputable section

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Scheme.Modules

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private lemma unit_hom_ext_top {X : Scheme.{0}} {M : X.Modules}
    (s t : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ M)
    (h : s.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)) =
      t.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) : s = t := by
  apply M.unitHomEquiv.injective
  refine PresheafOfModules.sections_ext _ _ fun U => ?_
  have hs := (M.unitHomEquiv s).property (homOfLE (show U.unop ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
  have ht := (M.unitHomEquiv t).property (homOfLE (show U.unop ≤ ⊤ from le_top)).op
  change M.val.presheaf.map _ (s.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) =
    s.val.app U (1 : Γ(X, U.unop)) at hs
  change M.val.presheaf.map _ (t.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, ⊤))) =
    t.val.app U (1 : Γ(X, U.unop)) at ht
  exact hs.symm.trans ((congrArg (M.val.presheaf.map _) h).trans ht)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
private lemma isIso_restrict_opensRange_of_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{0}}
    (j : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] {M N : X.Modules} (s : M ⟶ N)
    [IsIso ((pullback j).map s)] :
    IsIso ((restrictFunctor j.opensRange.ι).map s) := by
  let e : restrictFunctor j.opensRange.ι ≅
      pullback j ⋙ pullback j.isoOpensRange.inv :=
    restrictFunctorIsoPullback j.opensRange.ι ≪≫
      (pullbackCongr j.isoOpensRange_inv_comp).symm ≪≫
      (pullbackComp j.isoOpensRange.inv j).symm
  apply (NatIso.isIso_map_iff e s).mpr
  change IsIso ((pullback j.isoOpensRange.inv).map ((pullback j).map s))
  infer_instance

end Scheme.Modules

namespace ProjTwist

variable (n : Type)

/-- The chart value of the coordinate defining that chart is one. -/
lemma formChart_coord_self (i : n) :
    formChart 1 i ⟨X i, X_mem_deg_one n i⟩ = 1 := by
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  rw [formChart, Away.val_mk, HomogeneousLocalization.val_one]
  simpa only [pow_one] using Localization.mk_self
    (⟨(X i : MvPolynomial n (ULift.{0} ℤ)), 1, pow_one _⟩ : Submonoid.powers (X i))

/-- The global coordinate section as a morphism from the structure sheaf. -/
def coordinateHomGlued (i : n) :
    SheafOfModules.unit (glueData n).glued.ringCatSheaf ⟶ serreTwistGlued n 1 :=
  Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection (serreTwistGlued n 1) (coordSectionGlued i)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- On the coordinate's own chart, its descent projection is the structural map. -/
lemma coordinateHomGlued_glueProj (i : n) :
    coordinateHomGlued n i ≫ Scheme.Modules.glueProj (glueData n)
      (fun i => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U i).ringCatSheaf)
      (fun i j => twistTransition n 1 i j)
      (fun i => twistTransition_self n 1 i)
      (fun i j k => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 i j k) i =
      SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit ((glueData n).ι i).toRingCatSheafHom := by
  apply Scheme.Modules.unit_hom_ext_top
  change (Scheme.Modules.glueProj (glueData n)
      (fun i => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U i).ringCatSheaf)
      (fun i j => twistTransition n 1 i j)
      (fun i => twistTransition_self n 1 i)
      (fun i j k => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 i j k) i).app ⊤
        ((Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection (serreTwistGlued n 1)
          (coordSectionGlued i)).app ⊤ (1 : Γ((glueData n).glued, ⊤))) = _
  rw [Scheme.Modules.homOfGlobalSection_app_top_one, glueProj_coordSectionGlued,
    formChart_coord_self, map_one]
  exact ((((glueData n).ι i).toRingCatSheafHom.hom.app (.op ⊤)).hom.map_one).symm

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The coordinate section is invertible after pullback to its own chart. -/
theorem isIso_pullback_coordinateHomGlued (i : n) :
    IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ((glueData n).ι i)).map
      (coordinateHomGlued n i)) := by
  let e := Scheme.Modules.glueRestrictionIso (glueData n)
    (fun i => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U i).ringCatSheaf)
    (fun i j => twistTransition n 1 i j)
    (fun i => twistTransition_self n 1 i)
    (fun i j k => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 i j k) i
  have h : (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((glueData n).ι i)).map
      (coordinateHomGlued n i) ≫ e.hom =
      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackUnitIso ((glueData n).ι i)).hom := by
    change (Scheme.Modules.pullback ((glueData n).ι i)).map
        (coordinateHomGlued n i) ≫
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction ((glueData n).ι i)).homEquiv _ _).symm
          (Scheme.Modules.glueProj (glueData n)
            (fun i => SheafOfModules.unit ((glueData n).U i).ringCatSheaf)
            (fun i j => twistTransition n 1 i j)
            (fun i => twistTransition_self n 1 i)
            (fun i j k => twistTransition_cocycle n 1 i j k) i) = _
    rw [← Adjunction.homEquiv_naturality_left_symm, coordinateHomGlued_glueProj]
    rfl
  haveI : IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ((glueData n).ι i)).map
      (coordinateHomGlued n i) ≫ e.hom) := h.symm ▸ inferInstance
  exact (isIso_comp_right_iff _ e.hom).mp inferInstance

/-- The coordinate sections locally generate the glued `O(1)`. -/
theorem serreTwistGlued_locally_generating_unit_hom :
    ∀ x : (glueData n).glued,
      ∃ (s : Scheme.Modules.Hom
        (SheafOfModules.unit (glueData n).glued.ringCatSheaf) (serreTwistGlued n 1))
        (W : (glueData n).glued.Opens),
        x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map s) := by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨i, z, rfl⟩ := (glueData n).ι_jointly_surjective x
  haveI := isIso_pullback_coordinateHomGlued n i
  exact ⟨coordinateHomGlued n i, ((glueData n).ι i).opensRange, ⟨z, rfl⟩,
    Scheme.Modules.isIso_restrict_opensRange_of_pullback _ _⟩

/-- Coordinate sections locally generate `O(1)` on the integral projective model. -/
theorem serreTwist_locally_generating_unit_hom :
    ∀ x : Proj (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ)),
      ∃ (s : Scheme.Modules.Hom
        (SheafOfModules.unit (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ))).ringCatSheaf)
        (serreTwist n 1))
        (W : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{0} ℤ))).Opens),
        x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map s) :=
  Scheme.Modules.locally_generating_unit_hom_pullback
    (inv (basicOpenCover n).fromGlued) (serreTwistGlued n 1)
    (serreTwistGlued_locally_generating_unit_hom n)

/-- Coordinate sections locally generate relative `O(1)` over any base scheme. -/
theorem twistingSheaf_locally_generating_unit_hom (S : Scheme.{0}) :
    ∀ x : ℙ(n; S),
      ∃ (s : Scheme.Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit (ℙ(n; S)).ringCatSheaf)
        (ProjectiveSpace.twistingSheaf n S 1)) (W : (ℙ(n; S)).Opens),
        x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map s) :=
  Scheme.Modules.locally_generating_unit_hom_pullback
    (ProjectiveSpace.toProjInt n S) (serreTwist n 1)
    (serreTwist_locally_generating_unit_hom n)

end ProjTwist

namespace Scheme.Hom.IsProjectiveWith

variable {X S : Scheme.{0}} {π : X ⟶ S} {L : X.Modules}

/-- A carried projective bundle is locally generated by its global sections. -/
theorem locally_generating_unit_hom (h : π.IsProjectiveWith L) :
    ∀ x : X,
      ∃ (s : Scheme.Modules.Hom (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) L)
        (W : X.Opens), x ∈ W ∧ IsIso ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map s) := by
  obtain ⟨n, _, i, _, _, ⟨e⟩⟩ := h
  exact Scheme.Modules.locally_generating_unit_hom_of_iso e.symm
    (Scheme.Modules.locally_generating_unit_hom_pullback i
      (ProjectiveSpace.twistingSheaf n S 1)
      (ProjTwist.twistingSheaf_locally_generating_unit_hom n S))

/-- The evaluation map of the line bundle carried by a projective morphism is epic. -/
theorem counit_epi (h : π.IsProjectiveWith L) :
    Epi ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction π).counit.app L) :=
  Scheme.Modules.counit_epi_of_locally_generating_unit_hom π L
    h.locally_generating_unit_hom

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- A carried projective bundle on a nonempty scheme has a nonzero global section. -/
theorem exists_globalSection_ne_zero [Nonempty X] (h : π.IsProjectiveWith L) :
    ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤), s ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
  obtain ⟨s, W, hxW, hs⟩ := h.locally_generating_unit_hom x
  letI : Nonempty W := ⟨⟨x, hxW⟩⟩
  letI := hs
  refine ⟨s.app ⊤ (1 : Γ(X, ⊤)), fun hz => ?_⟩
  have hs0 : s = (0 : SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf ⟶ L) :=
    Scheme.Modules.unit_hom_ext_top s 0 hz
  have hid : (𝟙 ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))) = 0 := by
    apply (cancel_mono ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor W.ι).map s)).mp
    simp [hs0]
  letI : Nonempty (W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤) := ⟨⟨x, ⟨⟨x, hxW⟩, trivial, rfl⟩⟩⟩
  have hone := congrArg
    (fun f => f.val.app (.op ⊤) (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤))) hid
  change (1 : Γ(X, W.ι ''ᵁ ⊤)) = 0 at hone
  exact one_ne_zero hone

end Scheme.Hom.IsProjectiveWith

end AlgebraicGeometry
